instruction: Please set the maximum volume limit in VLC Media Player to 300%. Some of my audio files have very low recording levels and I need extra amplification beyond the default limit.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC's maximum volume to 300%. The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_max_volume metric to verify that qt-max-volume is set to 300. Similar difficulty to variation 1 but with a different target value, testing the agent's ability to set specific numeric values in preferences.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts VLC configuration file using get_vlc_config getter
Metric check_qt_max_volume correctly parses the qt-max-volume setting from the config file
